## What changes for a person using the plugin

## How it was checked

- [ ] `composer check` passes
- [ ] `ci/run.sh` passes
- [ ] A check in `tests/` fails without this change
- [ ] `lib/packout-core/` is untouched, or is a new exported version with its lock
- [ ] Anything new the plugin sends to another server is described in `readme.txt`
